question: Seven people, F, G, H, I, J, K and R, are sitting in a row facing North. Only two people sit between H and R. Only F sits to the right of J. Only one person sits between R and J. G sits at some place to the right of I but at some place to the left of K. Who sits third from the right end of the line?
solution:
Seven people, F, G, H, I, J, K and R, are sitting in a row facing North.

 
• Only two people sit between H and R.
 
• Only F sits to the right of J.
 
• Only one person sits between R and J.
 
• G sits at some place to the right of I but at some place to the left of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2bc87b58c688f4146f2d11403b6c2a4e0810f738e81b132b58bf366f76f2eff5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
